mission: Replace wedged/slow selfhost CPU Spaces with freshest HF community models (≤3B params or MoE with ≤4B active) + top-3 cloud free tiers for real-time TF.

constraints.hardware: HF free CPU Space (2 vCPU / 16GB RAM / no GPU)
constraints.downstream: NBA / Political / PQTF / ITF trading agents — need reasoning + instruction-following

selfhost_recommendations.rationale: Gemma 4 Nano E2B — Google DeepMind, MatFormer + Per-Layer Embedding cache, designed for on-device. Day-1 llama.cpp support. 128K context, multimodal-capable but we'd run text-only. Best raw reasoning/footprint ratio on CPU free tier.
Gemma 4 Nano E4B — bigger brother of E2B. Same Apr 2 2026 drop, roughly matches Gemma 3-12B on reasoning while fitting CPU. Direct replacement for existing gemma3-4b alias with measurable uplift.

Qwen 3.5 4B — Mar 2 2026 drop. Dual thinking/non-thinking mode, strong on reasoning + function calling. Direct upgrade over our stale Qwen3-4B (Aug 2025). Unsloth Dynamic 2.0 quantization preserves accuracy vs naive Q4.

Qwen 3.5 9B — fits 16GB RAM with room to spare. Better reasoning headroom if we can tolerate 20-30s/call. Use as a fallback for complex prompts (coalition_proposal reasoning, CPCV-style explanations).

Microsoft Phi-4-mini 3.8B — MIT license, MMLU 68.5 at 3.5GB RAM footprint. Best instruction-following per byte. Already proven in Nomos42/nomos-cpu-gemma4 — keep the slot but refresh to instruct variant with current llama.cpp fixes.
selfhost_recommendations.priority: P0 — REPLACES existing phi35-mini-cpu (>90s timeout observed)

selfhost_recommendations.rationale: Hermes 3 Llama-3.2 3B — Nous Research tool-use + reasoning fine-tune. Best-in-class for agent-style JSON output (our TFs need clean alloc dicts). Hermes 4 small variant doesn't exist yet (only 14B/36B/70B/405B). License permits commercial.
selfhost_recommendations.benchmark_score: MMLU ~62, IFEval ~75, structured output >95% valid JSON

selfhost_recommendations.rationale: Meta Llama 3.2 3B instruct — reliable baseline, outperforms Gemma 2 2.6B + Phi-3.5-mini on benchmarks. Upgrade over our current 1B variant for better contrarian-persona reasoning.

Ai2 OLMoE — 7B total but only 1B active per token via MoE. Fully open (data + weights + recipe) = we can cite in research proposals without license ambiguity. Inference speed matches 1B dense on CPU. llama.cpp + vLLM + SGLang all integrated.
selfhost_recommendations.benchmark_score: MMLU ~54, IFEval ~68, GSM8K ~45 (lower but speed/openness compensate)
selfhost_recommendations.priority: P2 — NEW slot, add as 'disciplined-open' persona

selfhost_recommendations.rationale: HF's own SmolLM3 3B — trained on 11T tokens, dual thinking/non-thinking. Very CPU-friendly, tight instruction-following. Replaces our failed TESTforge42/smollm3-3b-cpu (which was correct target but build failed). Use official HF repo + prebuilt GGUF wheel.
selfhost_recommendations.priority: P1 — RETRY wedged TESTforge42/smollm3-3b-cpu (use unsloth/lmstudio-community prebuilt GGUF, not source compile)

selfhost_recommendations.rationale: Qwen 2.5 1.5B — only ~2GB RAM, great latency (~3-5s/call on CPU). Use as FAST fallback for when gateway times out on heavier models. Proven stable in community.

cloud_recommendations.rationale: Gemma 4 26B-A4B MoE — 25.2B total, 3.8B active per token → near-31B quality at 4B compute. Free tier on OpenRouter. Best free small-MoE available Apr 2026. Use to replace CPU selfhost for real-time TF calls where latency matters.
cloud_recommendations.free_tier_limits: 20 req/min, 200 req/day per account. Can stack across 3 OPENROUTER_API_KEY_{1,2,3}.
cloud_recommendations.priority: P0 — first cloud hop in gateway fallback chain

cloud_recommendations.rationale: Llama 3.3 70B — still GPT-4-class performance, free. Our existing T14 nvidia-llama70 routes to NVIDIA NIM; OpenRouter adds a second cheap lane. Good for contrarian/swing personas where we want heavy reasoning.
cloud_recommendations.free_tier_limits: 20 req/min, 200 req/day. Was 429 across 3 keys previously — still worth retrying after slot redistribution.

cloud_recommendations.rationale: Apriel 1.6 15B Thinker — Fireworks-hosted, FREE at 10 RPM without payment method. Thinker-class model = strong chain-of-thought (matches our reasoning-heavy personas). Adding a payment method unlocks 6000 RPM. No credit card needed to start.
cloud_recommendations.free_tier_limits: 10 RPM unthrottled, $1 credit on signup, 6000 RPM w/ payment method on file
cloud_recommendations.priority: P0 — new provider, diversifies away from Cerebras-Google-Mistral concentration

models_to_retire.reason: Observed >90s timeouts at 10-token max — structurally too slow for TF 4h loop. Replace with Phi-4-mini-instruct (smaller activation path, current llama.cpp optims) OR retire entirely in favor of cloud Gemma-4-26B-MoE.
Conn-refused / WEDGED. Supersede with Gemma 4 E2B (apr 2 2026) — same size-class, strictly newer architecture.
Build failed (source-compile timeout per memory selfhost_llm_expansion_apr19). Retry with prebuilt GGUF wheel + --prefer-binary, route still valid.
Build failed / 404. Same remedy as smollm3 — use prebuilt unsloth GGUF. Keep alias, supersede backing repo.

Underpowered vs newer 1B-class. Useful as fastest-possible emergency fallback but demote from primary routing (T16 selfhost-qwen06 persona). Consider retiring if Gemma 4 E2B + Qwen 2.5 1.5B both deploy stably.
Still functional but stale (Aug 2025). Swap backing GGUF to Qwen3.5-4B (Mar 2 2026) — same alias, same endpoint, strictly better benchmarks. Zero routing change needed.
Functional but superseded. Swap backing GGUF to Gemma 4 E4B for ~5pt MMLU uplift + better IFEval.

deployment_notes.build_recipe: Per project memory selfhost_llm_expansion_apr19: use `--prefer-binary --extra-index-url <llama-cpp-python wheel/cpu>`. Source compile ALWAYS times out HF free build. `hardware='cpu-basic'` required for HfApi.duplicate_space.
deployment_notes.account_routing: Per selfhost_fleet_reality_apr20 memory: do NOT push to Nomos42/* (403 saturated). Spread across LBJLincoln / LBJLincoln26 / TESTforge42 only.
deployment_notes.gateway_fix_required: Per selfhost_fleet_reality_apr20: gateway /api/models returns 0 selfhost: entries → prefix routing silently fails. MUST fix gateway model-registry before any new persona routes through selfhost:* alias. Until then, wire new aliases directly to cloud fallbacks (OpenRouter / Fireworks).
deployment_notes.delegation: Implementation → DR FRANKENSTEIN per HAWKEYE role (never HAWKEYE). This JSON is the proposal packet.

summary: 10 selfhost candidates (Gemma 4 E2B/E4B, Qwen 3.5 4B/9B, Phi-4-mini, Hermes 3 3B, Llama 3.2 3B, OLMoE 1B-7B, SmolLM3 3B, Qwen 2.5 1.5B) + 3 cloud (OpenRouter Gemma-4-26B-MoE, OpenRouter Llama-3.3-70B, Fireworks Apriel 1.6 15B). 7 current aliases flagged for retirement/refresh. Gateway selfhost: routing must be fixed first per existing memory.
